expo.name: Stourify
expo.description: Discover your next adventure — local spots, shared by explorers who actually go there.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Stourify uses your location to find spots near you and to place the spots you share.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Stourify uses your camera to capture the spots you share.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Stourify needs your photo library to attach photos to the spots you share.
